designNotes.topic: the typed skip reason's literal name
designNotes.note: The spec requires 'a typed skip diagnostic' and the task 'a named skip reason', but NEITHER the spec delta, the task text, the r2-client-spec-delta-20260915 evidence (correction/RE-1), nor the admission brief pins a literal identifier -- grepped all four for skipReason / over-cap / keepalive-* and found only prose. The name chosen is 'envelope-over-keepalive-cap', derived from the spec scenario's own wording ('An envelope past the keepalive body cap'). Flagged rather than claimed as spec-given: if the parent wants a different literal, it is a one-token rename in the store plus one test assertion.

designNotes.topic: legacyUnadopted skip is a third condition the task did not enumerate
designNotes.note: The task names two skips (not dirty, co-op). A THIRD was added: legacyUnadopted. Rationale -- runSave already returns { status: 'skipped' } for an unadopted legacy copy (useCampaignPersistenceStore.ts, runSave guard) so no PUT reaches the server on that path today; a flush without this guard would be the FIRST write that turns an unadopted legacy copy into a server record, which is exactly what the D8 adoption gate forbids. This is a bug-avoidance guard, not a scope expansion, and it contradicts nothing in the spec (which scopes the flush to 'unsaved mutations pending' on this PUT path). Surfaced here so the reviewer can reject it explicitly if the parent disagrees.
designNotes.untested: No dedicated test row asserts the legacyUnadopted skip -- the required sibling-row list does not name one and the cap was already tight. It is a code-level guard with no regression row.

designNotes.topic: listener install precedes the campaign-store accessor check
designNotes.note: installCampaignPersistenceWiring returns early when getCampaignStoreForRoster() is null. installDiscardFlushListeners() is called BEFORE that early return, and before the unsubscribe idempotency guard, so the flush listeners register even where the campaign-store accessor is not yet registered. Both helpers are idempotent and guard typeof window === 'undefined' for SSR.

TextEncoder().encode(body).length, not body.length: the cap is a byte budget, so a character count would under-measure any non-ASCII campaign name or note and fire a request the browser then rejects silently. TextEncoder verified present in this repo's jsdom jest environment by a throwaway probe test (removed) and is universally available wherever fetch keepalive is.

designNotes.topic: flushSkip is never cleared by a later save
designNotes.note: Only flushPendingMutations writes the field; reset() restores INITIAL_STATE. A skipped over-cap discard stays visible rather than being wiped by the next successful auto-save, because the condition it reports (an envelope that has outgrown the mechanism) persists.

nonClaimsAddedOnReviewerRequest: NB-1: flushSkip has ZERO consumers. A grep over src/ finds it only in the store and this test file. The spec asks that the condition be RECORDED, and it is -- but nothing yet shows it to anyone, so an over-cap discard is observable to a developer reading state, not to a player. Surfacing it is not claimed by this prefix.

NB-2: the flush is NOT sequenced through saveChain and does NOT await inFlightLoad, unlike runSave. A flush can therefore overlap an in-flight ordinary save or a load. Both races are refused safely by the server compare-and-swap and neither can produce a silent overwrite, but the asymmetry with the ordinary save path is deliberate (a discarding document cannot wait on a queue) and is recorded rather than hidden.

The reconciliation added for RE-2 re-arms a SAVE; it does not re-validate the cache against the stream head and does not resync baseVersion. A landed keepalive write therefore still routes the next save into the existing 409 conflict flow, whose only resolution remains take-server. That consequence is now PINNED by a test row rather than left to be discovered, but it is not eliminated -- eliminating it needs head re-validation on return, which is not in this prefix and not in task 1.6.
